definitions.meaning: Real dxd symmetric matrices with I_d <= A <= kappa I_d.
definitions.domain: d integer >=1; real kappa>=1; Euclidean/Loewner conventions in S2.
obligations: Preserve symmetry as well as both spectral inequalities.
No arbitrary-matrix fallback to zero or default positive precision.

definitions.meaning: f_A(x)=V_A(x)=x^T A x/2 on the whole real Euclidean carrier.
obligations: Preserve the factor 1/2, transpose/inner-product convention, and all-x domain.
C.4 changes the letter f to V; identify only the identical displayed quadratic.
Gradient formula is derivative output; do not silently define gradient to be Ax without derivative meaning.

definitions.meaning: Exact ordered pair (quadratic value, mathematical gradient)=(x^T A x/2,Ax).
obligations: Preserve value and vector components, common query x, input A and real exact arithmetic.
For hard-family use derive membership/symmetry; no assumption that merely restates oracle correctness.

definitions.domain: d>=2, kappa>=2, i=1,...,d; O real orthogonal.
obligations: Preserve the half-node cosine grid, order/indexing and same O across kappa comparisons.
Do not replace the cosine grid by an arbitrary spectrum inside [1,kappa].
Haar and seed independence govern the randomized experiment; pointwise facts quantify every orthogonal O.

definitions.meaning: Centered Gaussian N(0,A^{-1}) with A a precision, not covariance.
obligations: Derive A inverse exists from positive definiteness.
Do not swap precision/covariance, introduce a nonzero mean, or normalize with the wrong base measure.

definitions.literal_vs_inferred: C.4 does not literally spell out integral exp(-V_A) dx. That conventional meaning and Gaussian-integration proof must be discharged separately.
obligations: Use real Lebesgue Gaussian normalization, positive determinant and real square-root convention.
Keep finite/positive integral and determinant invariance as proof edges.
Public fixed spectrum supplies information, not an expected-cost oracle or executable bit-complexity bound.

definitions.meaning: Borel queries/stopping/output from independent internal randomness and past responses; arbitrary Rd-valued Borel output.
obligations: Keep independence from input and full history dependence.
Do not force output into the query/reply span.
This predicate is not a chosen unique algorithm; no artificial existence/default object.

definitions.meaning: At most T queries for every admissible input AND every realization of the seed.
obligations: Universal runwise cap, including stopping behavior, is stronger than an expectation bound.
No expected-query complexity is defined in the scoped source; its replacement requires a distinct claim.

definitions.meaning: sup over measurable B of |P(B)-Q(B)| = one-half L1 density difference under any common dominating measure.
obligations: Preserve the factor 1/2 and measurable-set scope.
The test bound requires measurable h in [0,1].

definitions.meaning: Infimum of T in nonnegative integers for which some fixed-cap algorithm has sup_A TV(output-law-with-seed-averaged,pi_A)<=epsilon.
obligations: Keep quantifier order exists Alg then uniform sup over A, and separate averaged output accuracy from pointwise cap.
Do not invent empty-feasible-set fallback zero; the scoped text does not specify a Lean codomain/default convention.
No seedwise TV guarantee is asserted.

definitions.meaning: The unique global minimizer of the literal potential is zero.
obligations: Prove zero attains the minimum and no other point does, using positive gap.
No if-exists default, choice witness, minimizer uniqueness, or gap premise may be added to a source-facing theorem.

definitions.literal_vs_inferred: Words/constants are literal C.4; Bregman-inequality/Lipschitz-gradient semantic expansions are inferred conventional adapters.
obligations: Source supplies these as conclusions. Derive from Hessian bounds on all Rd.
No added higher derivative, integrability or bounded-domain premise.
Preserve q+1 seed vectors, degree q and coefficient dependence on full experiment.
Do not identify dimension with generator count without the separate dimension lemma.
